decisions.reason: Accepting preset and custom tip controls does not change the Transak provider, conversion asset, supported fiat methods, or buyer prerequisites.
The tipping-control decision does not change fiat buyers' dashboard authentication, reward access, or wallet requirements.
The accepted controls include a zero-dollar option and belong to an already optional tipping mechanism; they do not change the $15 base mint price or establish a mandatory additional charge.
The source specifies selectable tip amounts but does not change the allocation of primary-sale proceeds or establish how tips are allocated.
Adding preset and custom tip controls does not alter the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
The tipping UI decision does not modify referral qualification, the $5 commission, its recipient, or payment delivery.
Tip amount controls do not change how referral codes are created, owned, persisted, or displayed.
The acceptance concerns mint-page tipping controls and does not request any corresponding change to the About page copy.
Optional primary-mint tipping controls do not change secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, or whether secondary sales generate tickets.
The source does not modify badge triggers, milestone thresholds, or badge destinations.
The accepted tip options do not alter Small Block prize funding, ticket issuance, winner count, prize amount, or draw timing.
The accepted tip options do not alter Big Block prize funding, ticket issuance, winner selection, prize amount, or draw trigger.
